rule: The most specific later user-approved lock wins only where it explicitly changes behavior. Otherwise frozen Pass authority remains canonical and Bridge 003 is additive.

domains.mergeRule: Keep complete Union Forecast selection, shared AP, personal MP, visible non-clickable predictions, and no grid/direct movement.
Identity records remain byte-authoritative. Bridge 003 adds fixed-family/progression adapters without rewriting source records.
Use CA002 identity IDs and Bridge 003 personalization. Do not invent replacements.
The six starting classes and eighteen advanced classes remain canonical; four CA002 hybrid foundations are additive use-unlocked routes.
Existing 147 Art IDs retain their effects and stable IDs. CA002 nodes organize learn-by-use progression and may reference legacy Arts; they do not rename them.
Existing 60 weapons, 24 body armors, 12 offhands, and 30 accessories remain field-identical. Only CA002 metadata is overlaid; new CA002 IDs are additive.
Existing 24 opening paths remain valid. CA002 extends each family to three Training-to-Godly paths; Bridge 003 binds tier to Art discovery without auto-learning.
Do not create a second mission engine. CA002 world loot tables attach rewards to existing contract/board/operation authority.
Do not replace the existing city builder. CA002 facility hooks connect the 30 trees to existing facilities and preserve separate XP ledgers.
Use Pass 06 event/relationship systems and CA002 character quest seeds. Bridge signature techniques remain implementation candidates until presentation assets exist.
ZIP 21 remains the visual floor. Content import cannot redesign accepted screens, camera, scene, art, or battle flow.
Never normalize into the 300-recruit/equipment/progression system. Kael remains 300/300, zero normal stats, unequipped, one-person Union, automatic same-value True Reflection.

forbiddenResolution: Do not ask Codex to choose between duplicate systems.
